prose: Specified in the design and not built until hv rules it on. The safety condition is the specification: the redirect fires only when the envelope says the index is COMPLETE for the paths the pattern would have reached, never otherwise -- a redirect answering from a stale index hands the model a confident wrong answer in place of a fresh right one, and the model cannot tell it happened. With three conditions that are each a way that rule could be lost: a pattern that is not symbol-shaped is never redirected, the model is told when a call was redirected, and the redirect shares one freshness rule with dc's PostToolUse hook and owns none of its own.
